situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hey. got a minute? been meaning to say something for a while
Yes. Go ahead.
sorry i've been dodging the money thing. i know it's been way longer than i said and i should've brought it up myself instead of you having to wonder
work's been slow, still is, but that's not an excuse for going quiet
I did wonder. I didn't want to be the one to bring it up every time, so I waited.
Thank you for saying it, though.
what if i do a fixed amount every month. 3k to start, on the 5th. i know it's small but i'd rather give you something i can actually keep up than promise a big number and miss it
and if a good month comes i'll send extra
3k on the 5th works. What I need is for it to actually arrive. If a month is going to be bad, tell me before the 5th, not after.
deal. i'll tell you before
first one is 5th december then
Fine. I'll keep a note of it so we both know where it stands.
ok. thanks sneha, really
Did you eat yet? You said you were at the café earlier.
lol no, still here. the owner's about to throw me out i think
going home to make maggi
Add an egg at least.
yes ma'am 🙂
egg added. it was a good egg
Good.
Reached the pharmacy early. Delivery truck is already here and nobody has the keys.
lol who has the keys
The manager. Who is stuck in traffic on the Baner road.
Got in eventually.
did you see the match last night? i fell asleep before the end

we lost. in the last over, obviously
i'll spare you the details
Appreciated.
client finally paid an old invoice today. not huge but helps
That's good news. Maybe the 5th will be easier then.
yeah hoping so. will keep you posted either way
Pharmacy opens late today, inventory count. Going to be a long one.
ugh. good luck with the counting
random but do you remember that dosa place near fergusson we used to go to after exams

Why?
walked past it today. it's a phone shop now
felt weirdly sad about it
That's a pity. Their chutney was the only good thing about those years.
lol harsh. the friends were also good
Fine. Second only to the chutney.
Count finished. I never want to see another box of paracetamol.
😂 sorry for your loss
got a new logo project from a bakery in sadashiv peth. small but it's something

yeah already asked for 50%
